exposure: Type of Differences of Sex Development (DSD)
outcome: Variability of sex assignment at birth
cohort: Participants were individuals diagnosed with Differences of Sex Development (DSD) who presented to a tertiary center in Assam over a 10-year period.
finding: The most prevalent DSD type was 46, XY DSD (61.2%), followed by 46, XX DSD (19.7%) and sex chromosome DSD (19.1%), with sex assignment at birth being influenced by the degree of ambiguity.
